Steige ein - steige auf!

Se vivete in una città, è probabile che vi daremo un ascensore o un ruolo nel tenervi in movimento ogni giorno.

Otis è l'azienda leader mondiale nella produzione, installazione e servizio di ascensore e scale mobili. Ci muoviamo 2,4 miliardi di persone ogni giorno e manteniamo circa 2,4 milioni di unità clienti in tutto il mondo, il più grande portafoglio di servizi del settore.

Potete riconoscere i nostri prodotti in alcuni dei punti di riferimento più famosi del mondo, tra cui la Torre Eiffel, l'Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa e le Petronas Twin Towers! Siamo 72,000 persone forti, tra cui ingegneri, esperti di tecnologia digitale, vendite e specialisti funzionali, nonché tecnici di fabbrica e campo, tutti impegnati a soddisfare le diverse esigenze dei nostri clienti e passeggeri in oltre 200 paesi e territori in tutto il mondo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un team diversificato e globale con una comprovata eredità di innovazione che continua ad essere la base di una società veloce e performante.

Quando ti unisci a Otis, diventi parte di un innovativo leader mondiale nel settore con un modello di business resiliente. Appartenerai a una comunità diversificata, affidabile e premurosa dove i tuoi contributi, e le competenze e le capacità che otterrai lavorare insieme al meglio e più luminoso, ci tengono connessi e all'avanguardia.

Forniamo opportunità, formazione e risorse, che costruiscono leadership e capacità in Vendite, Field, Ingegneria e Progetti Maggiori e il nostro programma di studio dei dipendenti è un punto di orgoglio notevole, attraverso il quale Otis sponsorizza i colleghi a perseguire gradi o programmi di certificazione.

Oggi, il nostro focus più che mai è sulle persone. Come azienda globale, alimentata da persone, mettiamo persone – passeggeri, clienti e colleghi – al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo guidati dai nostri valori che chiamiamo i nostri Tre Assoluti – privilegiando Sicurezza, Etica, Qualità in tutto ciò che facciamo. Se volete saperne di più su ambiente, sociale e governance (ESG) a Otis clicca qui.

Diventa parte della squadra Otis e aiutaci #Buildwhatsnext!
Otis è un dipendente di pari opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, colore, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, disabilità o status veterano, età, o qualsiasi altra classe protetta secondo la legge applicabile. Per richiedere un alloggio nel completamento di una domanda di lavoro a causa di una necessità speciale o di una disabilità, si prega di contattarci a careers@otis.com.

• EKAS-recognized certification is an advantage

• Experience working with SUVA and regulatory authorities is desirable

• Strong leadership, communication, and assertiveness skills

• Languages: Fluent German and English, and ideally good knowledge of French

• Willingness to travel within Switzerland (approximately 50%)

Date Posted: 2026-04-03Country: SwitzerlandLocation: Route de Moncor 12, CP 464, 1701 FribourgJob Description HR Business Partner Switzerland Role Context The HR Business Partner develops and implements both long-term and short-term strategies that align structure, culture, and talent with business goals, providing individual support and coaching for the Swiss area. They offer expertise and guidance in areas such as HR and business strategy alignment, organizational design, workforce planning, employee engagement, and culture and change management. The role fosters a positive and inclusive work environment as a competitive advantage. Among the many topics over and above the already mentioned are:
• Develop a people strategy aligned with global and regional strategies.
• Collaborate with business leadership on talent management, organizational design, strategic workforce planning, and culture development.
• Partner / Broker with HR COEs, functional HRBPs to ensure implementation of appropriate/ aligned strategies, programs & processes. Partnering with the COEs (Talent Acquisition, Talent Development, Change Management, Total Reward):
• Develop and implement strategies to attract, develop, and retain diverse talent.
• Personal ownership for key HR metrics (recruitment, development, retention, etc.) for their client group, making deep dive to root cause and develop and execute appropriate countermeasures where needed.
• Lead talent assessment in the organization, identifying key employee strengths and development needs to select, retain and develop key talent.
• Lead succession planning and talent development strategies for the organization, identifying critical roles and preparing potential talent and pipelines.
• Drive and sustain the key processes around engagement, from analysis, communication, feedback, and action planning.
• Lead client groups through critical HR operating rhythms such as merit & bonus planning, performance management and Talent Review.
• Being the escalation point for complex case management and provides expert advice to managers on employee issues including discipline and grievance.
• Works with leaders and managers to professionally execute corporate policies and HR programs ensuring appropriate and agreed levels of quality, delivery and cost.
• Partner & manage local labor & employee relations ensuring legal compliance.
• Serve as a member of the Swiss leadership team, the pension foundation board, and the works council. Professional Experience / Qualification
• Co- create, implement, and execute programs to support the business & people strategy
• You have a degree and / or the 'eidgenössische Fachausweis (FA) im Personalwesen/HR' , having a strong knowledge of Swiss labor laws, regulations, and HR practices with a proven experience in Employee Relations, conflict resolution, or mediation and knowledge of collective bargaining law
• You enjoy shaping change processes and feel comfortable in a matrix organization.
• You can keep several balls in the air at the same time and don't let yourself get rattled.
• You enjoy working with people and impress with your high level of social skills, team orientation and confident demeanor.
• You are well-versed in MS Office 365 and have already worked with Workday.
• Fluency in French as well as German are a prerequisite
• Since we work in an international environment, fluent written and spoken English is also mandatory
• You have strong change management expertise and a solid understanding of business and financial topics. You are open to travel across our Swiss sites to partner with in-country teams where needed. We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company. If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day. Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio. You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company. When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge. We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs. Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do. We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other protected class according to applicable law. To request an accommodation in completing an employment application due to a special need or a disability, please contact us at careers@otis.com. Among the many topics over and above the already mentioned are: • Develop a people strategy aligned with global and regional strategies. • Collaborate with business leadership on talent management, organizational design, strategic workforce planning, and culture development. • Partner / Broker with HR COEs, functional HRBPs to ensure implementation of appropriate/ aligned strategies, programs & processes. descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Date Posted: 2026-04-15
Country: Switzerland
Location: Sandackerstrasse 26, 9245 Oberburen

## Mansioni
- Du bist verantwortlich für den reibungslosen Betrieb unserer Anlagen. Dies beinhaltet folgende Aufgaben:
- Du führst regelmässige Wartungs- und Reparaturarbeiten an mechanischen, hydraulischen, elektrischen und elektronischen Komponenten von Aufzügen und Fahrtreppen durch
- Du identifizierst selbstständig Reparatur- und Verbesserungsarbeiten an den Anlagen und bestellst die nötigen Ersatzteile
- Du führst mit Hilfe moderner Hilfsmittel Fehlersuchen durch und beseitigst die Störungen

## Requisiti
- Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung wie Elektromonteur:in, Polymechaniker:in, Automobilfachmann:frau oder ähnlich.
- Wenn du dich mit Liften bereits auskennst ist das ein grosser Vorteil.
- Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch
- Du planst und koordinierst eigenständig deinen Tag und legst ein freundliches Auftreten an den Tag
- Einen Führerschein der Kategorie B setzen wir voraus, ebenso wie einen Wohnort im Einsatzgebiet damit du die Pikettzeiten einhalten kannst

## Cosa offriamo
- Bei deinem Start bei uns wirst du von einem erfahrenen Kollegen begleitet, welcher dir wertvolles Fachwissen auf deinen Weg mitgibt.
- Du wirst mit einem Mobiltelefon und einem eigenen Firmenfahrzeug ausgestattet, welches du auch privat benutzen darfst.
- Uns liegt deine persönliche Entwicklung am Herzen. Konkret bedeutet dies, dass wir Weiterbildungen unterstützen und interne Beförderungsmöglichkeiten jedem offenstehen.
- Gute Pensionskasse
- 5 Wochen Ferien
- Verpflegungszuschuss
- Unsere Firmenkultur ist unser wichtigstes Gut und ist tief im Unternehmen verankert und wird von allen Mitarbeitern gelebt und geschätzt. Mehr Informationen über unsere «Otis Absolutes» findest Du hier.

## Contatto
Steige ein – Steige auf!
Haben wir dich überzeugt? Dann wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge. 

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do.  We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do. If you would like to learn more about environmental, social and governance (ESG) at Otis click here.

Become a part of the Otis team and help us #Buildwhatsnext!
Otis is An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other protected class according to applicable law. To request an accommodation in completing an employment application due to a special need or a disability, please contact us at careers@otis.com.
